description: Replace the existing MiSmart Health Care (MiUHC) calculator in the Kalkulator Premi tab with a MiSSION Syariah premium calculator. Remove all MiUHC data arrays (PREMI_KONV, PREMI_SYARIAH for health) and the related JS functions. Replace with a new calculator that computes kontribusi for the MiSSION Syariah base product + optional riders (MiSmart Waiver Syariah, MiSmart Critical Care Syariah).
steps: 1. In /projects/sandbox/Project-mission/index.html, locate the Kalkulator Premi tab content (line ~478, `<!-- Tab 6: Kalkulator Premi -->` through line ~527 before `<!-- Tab 7: Ilustrasi -->`). Replace the entire HTML content of this tab with the new MiSSION Syariah calculator UI.

2. The new tab HTML should contain: (a) Title 'Kalkulator Kontribusi MiSSION Syariah', (b) Brief explanation that MiSSION is Syariah-only, (c) Input controls: Jenis Kelamin (Pria/Wanita), Usia (18-70), Santunan Asuransi Dasar (dropdown: 100jt, 250jt, 500jt, 750jt, 1M, 1.5M, 2M, 3M), Metode Bayar (Tahunan/Semesteran/Kuartalan/Bulanan), (d) Checkbox for MiSmart Waiver Syariah rider, (e) Checkbox for MiSmart Critical Care Syariah rider with santunan selector (min 20jt, max 6x base santunan), (f) Results display area.

3. The results display should show: Kontribusi Dasar per selected period, Ujrah (Fee) Dasar, Kontribusi per rider (if selected), Ujrah per rider, and Total Kontribusi (dasar + riders) per selected period. Use the existing card/info-box styling patterns.

4. In the <script> section, remove the entire IIFE block starting with `// ============ KALKULATOR PREMI MiSmart Health Care ============` (line ~745) through the closing `})();` of that IIFE (around line ~930). This removes the massive PREMI_KONV and PREMI_SYARIAH data arrays and all MiUHC calculator functions (populateAgeSelect, calculatePremi, premiBuildCard, switchPremiTab, togglePremiAllPlans).

5. Add new JavaScript for the MiSSION Syariah calculator. Build a rate table based on the user-provided sample data points. Known rates per 1M santunan (annual kontribusi dasar): Pria age 31 = 8,140,000; Wanita age 37 = 8,750,000; Wanita age 40 = 9,380,000. Use linear interpolation between known ages and extrapolate reasonably for other ages (rates increase with age due to mortality).
6. Ujrah rates per 1M santunan (annual): Pria age 31 = 130,000; Wanita age 37 = 158,300; Wanita age 40 = 199,200. Interpolate similarly.

7. MiSmart Waiver Syariah rider rates per 1M base santunan (annual): Pria age 31 = 541,300; Wanita age 37 = 678,900; Wanita age 40 = 802,100. Ujrah for waiver per 1M: Pria 31 = 9,700; Wanita 37 = 22,000; Wanita 40 = 34,400. Scales linearly with base santunan.

8. MiSmart Critical Care Syariah rider rates per 1M CI santunan (annual): Pria age 31 = 8,640,000; Wanita age 37 = 14,540,000; Wanita age 40 = 16,590,000 (from data point 3: santunan CI 2M = 33,180,000 => per 1M = 16,590,000). Ujrah for CI per 1M: Pria 31 = 152,500; Wanita 37 = 361,700; Wanita 40 = 480,000 (from data point 3: 960,000/2M). CI santunan selector should enforce min 20jt and max 6x base santunan.
9. Payment frequency multipliers: Tahunan = 1x annual, Semesteran = annual/2, Kuartalan = annual/4, Bulanan = annual/12 (round to nearest 100).
10. All kontribusi and santunan values scale linearly with santunan amount (confirmed from data: 2M = exactly 2x the 1M rate).
11. Format all currency values in Indonesian format (e.g., 'Rp 8.750.000'). Use Bahasa Indonesia sederhana throughout the UI.
12. Ensure responsive design matching existing patterns. The calculator should look polished and follow the existing green color scheme (#00a758, #006838, #2ECC71).
13. Remove the Konvensional/Syariah tab toggle (calc-tabs with switchPremiTab) since MiSSION is ONLY Syariah.
14. Add a disclaimer at the bottom stating these are estimates for reference only.
15. Also remove the tab label text change - keep it as 'Kalkulator Premi' in the navigation tab.
acceptance_criteria: The Kalkulator Premi tab displays a MiSSION Syariah kontribusi calculator (not MiUHC health insurance)
No reference to MiUHC, MiSmart Health Care, Konvensional version, or health insurance plans remains in the kalkulator tab
All PREMI_KONV and PREMI_SYARIAH data arrays for health insurance are removed from the script section
Input fields exist for: Jenis Kelamin, Usia, Santunan Dasar, Metode Bayar, MiSmart Waiver checkbox, MiSmart Critical Care checkbox with santunan selector
For Wanita age 37, Santunan 1M, Tahunan: kontribusi dasar shows approximately 8,750,000 and ujrah shows approximately 158,300
For Pria age 31, Santunan 1M, Tahunan: kontribusi dasar shows approximately 8,140,000 and ujrah shows approximately 130,000
Payment frequency correctly divides annual amounts (semesteran /2, kuartalan /4, bulanan /12)
MiSmart Critical Care santunan is capped at max 6x base santunan and min 20jt
Total kontribusi correctly sums base + selected riders
The HTML file is valid and loads without JavaScript errors
No Konvensional/Syariah toggle exists in the calculator (MiSSION is Syariah only)
verification: Open /projects/sandbox/Project-mission/index.html and validate it parses without errors: grep for any remaining references to 'PREMI_KONV', 'PREMI_SYARIAH', 'MiSmart Health Care', 'switchPremiTab' in the kalkulator section
Verify the HTML structure is valid by checking tag matching and script section has no syntax errors
Verify sample data point: search for rate calculations that would produce ~8,750,000 for Wanita age 37 with 1M santunan
